value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Their CIO told us last Thursday that they are now \"slowing the Mac commitment\" until they see how Windows on Arm devices with the newest on-device AI tooling perform.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Mac fleet commitment at next refresh (22,000-seat financial services client)","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"A second client, a mid-size law firm, said the opposite: they're accelerating Mac replacement because IT support tickets are down.","tickers":["AAPL"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Mac replacement pace (law firm client)","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"Three clients with EAs up for renewal between January and March said Microsoft account teams are more flexible than at any point since 2022 on Copilot bundling.","tickers":["MSFT"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Microsoft flexibility on Copilot bundling in EA renewals","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"One was offered Copilot at roughly a 20% discount to list if they commit to a larger E5 footprint.","tickers":["MSFT"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Copilot discount to list offered with larger E5 commitment","period":null,"value":20,"unit":"pct","direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"Two of the three said they plan to adopt Copilot for a subset of users only.","tickers":["MSFT"],"entities":[],"kind":"channel_check","metric":"Copilot adoption plans among EA renewal clients","period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":true},{"quote":"My read is that both vendors are working harder for enterprise budget in a tighter-IT-spend environment.","tickers":["AAPL","MSFT"],"entities":[],"kind":"opinion","metric":null,"period":null,"value":null,"unit":null,"direction":null,"first_hand":false}]}
